segments.title: Eight-Hour Debate Stream Kickoff
segments.notes: Case Blackwell launches the eight-hour debate marathon, sets timer, fields chat questions about pre-show counting, and introduces upcoming segments including Munch & Crum, DJ Newsic, Jo Rogen Experience, Country Jamboree, and Trend at the Movies.

segments.title: Pre-Show Chat & Golden Kappa Hype Train
segments.notes: Kendall appears on couch cam; King Capitaran (golden kappa hype train persona) debuts with 'ass turns to gold' bit; early subs and bits trigger golden hype train; Case debates King Capitaran on monarchy vs democracy and best cartoon character smoking a spliff (Bugs Bunny wins).

segments.title: Jambalaya Debut: Secret Obama Voter
segments.notes: New 'infinite inky void' set hosts Chet, Liliana, Grandma Crumble Bottom, and Tyler in a 'secret blank' format where one contestant lies about voting for Obama; chat questions reveal Grandma Crumble Bottom voted for Romney/Green Party; segment mechanics tested for future use with guests.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Wiki Feet & Wife Verification
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate Kendall vs Kevin wiki feet (Munch wins), then whether Crum's wife Belulia is real (Crum wins narrowly after Munch super pack rally); Crum reveals daughters Denonia (17) and 12-year-old; gambling system not ready; millhouse trap beat plays.

segments.title: DJ Newsic vs Country Bear: Cinnamon vs Hawk Tuah
segments.notes: DJ Newsic debates a Country Bear on cinnamon vs spit as sexual lubricant; Country Bear argues for cinnamon with 'deep country voice'; DJ Newsic counters with spit; Country Bear's eyes eaten mid-debate; cinnamon declared winner by country logic.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Sweet vs Salty, Alien vs Predator
segments.notes: Debates: sweet vs salty (salty wins on culinary utility), Alien vs Predator (Predator wins on tribal fantasy), carnivore vs vegetarian diet (carnivore wins via 'lean bacon is a vegetable' logic); Joe Rogan segment teased.

segments.title: Double Joe Rogan: Banjo vs Sonic, Carnivore Diet, Fear Factor vs UFC
segments.notes: Two AI Joe Rogans debate banjo vs hedgehog fingering (Sonic wins, Joes lose 500k), carnivore diet (vegetarian wins, Joes lose 2.5M), Fear Factor vs UFC Joe Rogan (UFC wins); Jamie buried in VitaMix boxes giggling demonically.

segments.title: Bill & Tim Couch Takeover: Wizard Battles, Bedwetters, Cannibals
segments.notes: Guests Bill and Tim commandeer stream deck, run Jambalaya-style debates: secret cannibal (Tim revealed), secret bedwetter (Tim revealed at 16), wizard battle (tie), various street debates; Kendall asleep on couch; Pepito cheese works.

segments.title: Jambalaya Round Two: Secret Cannibal & Bedwetter
segments.notes: Second Jambalaya session with Bill, Tim, Liliana, Chet; secret cannibal (Tim), secret bedwetter (Tim again); Bill flees before reveal; Tim admits cannibalism consumes 'story and power'.

segments.title: Couch Debate: Smut vs No Smut
segments.notes: Case and Kendall debate smut as art form; Kendall argues for anticipation/titillation, Case argues eroticism is lowest art; Kendall concedes 'we lost, might have to try smut'; Zatch Bell cited as anti-smut evidence.

segments.title: Trip on the Street: Coin-Flip Street Debates
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein rapid-fire street debates settled by coin flips: Whoop There It Is (Tag Team wins), bread man raise (bread wins), Gragor the frog (Gragor wins), Cash vs Kevin lover (Cash wins), Power Rangers vs Golden Girls (Power Rangers wins), piss vs tentacles (piss wins), big vs small boobs (small wins), flip Bitcoin coin challenge (Flip Bitcoin wins), time construct (time is construct wins), jabroni vs motherfucker (jabroni wins), JD Vance body double (JD JD wins), Gundam vs Ultron (Gundam wins), anime smart vs real people smart (real people smart wins).

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Debate & Scat Lessons
segments.notes: Jeb and Dad (wooden board) debate who's better son (Dad picks Jet); Jeb learns RISA debate framework from Harvard champion; Bobby McFerrin vocal lesson leads to scat-off (both lose to wood resonance); Facekiller in wood acknowledged.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Gold vs Porcelain Teeth, Orphan Meat, Spoon vs Knife
segments.notes: Debates: gold vs porcelain teeth (porcelain wins on 'status symbol' logic), orphan meat preparation (tender and mild like Jesus wins), miso soup spoon vs Outback steakhouse knife (spoon wins on 'nape beauty'); Crum hits three straight wins, claims big spoon dominance.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Dener 89, Tattooed Teens, Cyber Squad, Death Date Rom-Com
segments.notes: Trailers: Dener 89 (Trent identifies as protagonist), Tattooed Teenage Alien Fighters from Beverly Hills 1994 (Trent wants reboot), Superhuman Samurai Cyber Squad (Jim Carrey theme wins on song), Running on Empty death-date dating movie (peg-heavy trailer panned); Trent debates best 80s time travel movie (Back to the Future beats Rock Star).

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Spike vs Luffy, Shaggy vs Jedi Shaggy, Country Jamboree
segments.notes: Debates: Spike Spiegel vs Luffy (Spike wins on humanism), Roger Rabbit resemblance (Crum as Baby Herman), Shaggy vs Jedi Shaggy (Jedi Shaggy wins on 'squaring circle'), Country Jamboree rap battle (Munch wins on 'down south' anthem); wolves vs turkeys lore expanded.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: National Anthem Butchery, Geometry Cheese, Dog Nature, Tall Women, RFK Ravens, 87-Year-Old TikTok
segments.notes: Video ratings: national anthem fail (8.1), polygon cheese slicer (9.9), ski juggling (9.38), dog catches treat (nature), tall women (unrated), RFK Jr ravens (low rated), 87-year-old sexually active TikTok (9); Peter Gibbon emerges from walls, civil, shares 'take that to the bank and smoke it' catchphrase.

segments.title: Conspiracy Time: Where Is He?
segments.notes: Guy Redacted investigates 'where is he' via YouTube clips: Salvador Alvarenga 438-day drift survival; interviews 'He' who doesn't know where he'll be after burrito; truth remains unsettled.

segments.title: Munch & Crum Finale: 8 vs 24 Hour Streams, Country Jamboree Rematch
segments.notes: Final debates: 8-hour vs 24-hour streams (8-hour wins on planning), Bobby McFerrin vs Scatman (unresolved), Country Jamboree rap battle rematch (Munch wins on 'down downtown' bridge); Munch claims wolf pack victory.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Dylan
segments.notes: Case wraps eight-hour debate stream, thanks chat, raids Dylan's Control stream with 'debate virus'; next week: Colin Show on Casim stream, possible news stream after.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News executes an eight-hour debate marathon spanning twelve segments, debuting the Jambalaya 'secret identity' format and a couch takeover by guests Bill and Tim. Munch and Crum clash across four debate blocks covering wiki feet, spouse verification, culinary philosophy, dental status symbols, orphan gastronomy, cutlery aesthetics, anime protagonists, and a country jamboree rap battle. Trip Bradstein settles street disputes by coin flip, Jeb learns Harvard debate frameworks from his wooden-board father, and DJ Newsic loses a country-logic duel to a smoking bear. The broadcast concludes with a raid on Dylan's Control stream, transmitting the 'debate virus'.
